Definition: from G2596 and G5530; to overuse, i.e. misuse:--abuse.
BiblicalUsage: Paul says to use the world without abusing it, and he himself refused to use his right to be paid for the gospel so nothing would hinder it.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the gospel is not a thing to be used up for my own advantage.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
